training.objective: Reconcile readiness source records and produce a truthful discrepancy handoff.
training.task: Independently compare a fresh synthetic packet with inventory, revision and handoff records; cite the facts and brief a proposed disposition.
training.standard: Identify all material seeded facts with sources, separate proposed from accepted actions, and preserve HOLD and decision authority when controls are unresolved.
training.change: Replace a guided familiarization walkthrough with independent source comparison, an explicit handoff and an evidence-based recommendation.
